definitions.gloss: sound of rain; patter of rain
definitions.explanation: The sound made by falling rain. A word with aesthetic and atmospheric associations, often used in literary and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {雨音|あまおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear the sound of rain.

examples.japanese: {雨音|あまおと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}り→眠り：13673_nemuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ついた。
examples.english: I fell asleep listening to the sound of the rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{雨音|あまおと}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{覚|さ}め→覚める：02058_sameru⟧、⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦なっていた→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was woken by the loud sound of rain, and when I looked outside, the road had turned into a river.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The kanji ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧ takes the combining form あま- in compounds: {雨音|あまおと}, ⟦{雨水|あまみず}→雨水：14607_amamizu⟧, ⟦{雨雲|あまぐも}→雨雲：22808_amagumo⟧. This あま- form is a common pattern in native Japanese compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨音|あまおと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧ (to hear the sound of rain)
- {雨音|あまおと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen to the rain)
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{雨音|あまおと} (heavy rain sound)
- ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な{雨音|あまおと} (quiet patter of rain)

SIMILAR COMPOUNDS:
Other ～⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧ compounds: ⟦{足音|あしおと}→足音：02991_ashioto⟧ (footsteps), ⟦{物音|ものおと}→物音：03633_monooto⟧ (noise/sound), {風音|かざおと} (sound of wind).
